mechanism: Ramipril may potentiate anticoagulant effects when vitamin K antagonists are used concurrently, and vitamin K can reduce warfarin efficacy, creating unpredictable anticoagulation if ramipril dosing changes affect warfarin levels.
action: Monitor INR closely if ramipril is initiated, discontinued, or dose-adjusted in patients on warfarin; maintain consistent vitamin K intake; counsel on bleeding precautions.
